title: Brand Team Contacts
slide_intent: Invite review while work can still change so collaborators can resolve brand questions before production decisions become fixed.
strategic_value: Early involvement of Regional and Global Marketing can help Burger King keep outside-vendor work aligned with its communications.
demonstration: A left paragraph explains when feedback adds value, while two large text blocks ask about questions and direct readers to Regional and Global Marketing.
practical_value: Route brand questions and draft communications to the named teams during development, especially when working with an outside vendor.

content_islands.name: Review timing
content_islands.spec: Place the Brand Team Contacts heading and development-phase feedback explanation at left.

content_islands.name: Question prompt
content_islands.spec: Set the large question about concerns or further information across the upper right.

content_islands.name: Contact direction
content_islands.spec: Place the Regional and Global Marketing instruction beneath the question in equally prominent type.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says feedback adds most value during development because there is still time to incorporate changes, especially with outside vendors.
reference_purposes.Application: The page directs branding questions and communications review to Regional and Global Marketing; it supplies no individual email or phone number.
